A student investigated the effect of an inhibitor on an enzyme.
A strip of agar gel containing the enzyme and its substrate was produced. The enzyme
breaks down (hydrolyses) the substrate to release a product which stains black when a
dye is added.
Small drops (2μl) of different concentrations of the inhibitor were put onto the surface of
the agar gel strip. After 10 minutes the agar gel strip was treated with the dye.
